hardmodeplus.config.title: HardmodePlus Settings
hardmodeplus.config.all_vanilla.tip: Clears all mob values and the multiplier (asks first). Profiles and options are kept.
hardmodeplus.config.note: White = vanilla · Yellow = changed · Green = saved · – = the mob doesn't have this
hardmodeplus.config.note_hard: Only on Hard. Total = General + area.
hardmodeplus.config.reset_row: Resets this mob's values in this tab to vanilla.
hardmodeplus.config.reset_section: Resets this whole group to default.
hardmodeplus.section.starve.tip: Damage at an empty food bar. Replaces the vanilla starvation damage. Only with "Hunger rules".
hardmodeplus.section.thirst_damage.tip: Damage at an empty thirst bar. Only with "Thirst".
hardmodeplus.section.drinks.tip: How much thirst a water bottle, milk, the canteen and a bowl of water quench. Only with "Thirst".
hardmodeplus.section.exhaust.tip: What happens when your stamina is empty: slower, no sprinting, slower mining. Only counts while "Stamina" is on.
hardmodeplus.config.per_mob_off: Values per mob are OFF right now (Options → Adjustment: Multiplier only).
hardmodeplus.config.hard_off: The multiplier is OFF right now (Options → Adjustment: Values per mob only).
hardmodeplus.config.column.percent.tip: How much stronger in percent. 50 = +50 %, -20 = 20 % weaker.
hardmodeplus.reset.title: Reset everything to vanilla?
hardmodeplus.reset.message: All values per mob and the multiplier are removed. Saved profiles and options are kept.
hardmodeplus.tab.mobs.tip: Values per mob type, split into combat, movement, senses & body and other.
hardmodeplus.tab.multiplier.tip: Extra percentage for all mobs, only on Hard difficulty.
hardmodeplus.tab.body.tip: Follow range, size, knockback resistance, gravity
hardmodeplus.kind.passive: Peaceful: own values only, no multiplier
hardmodeplus.stat.attack_damage.tip: Melee damage per hit before armor and difficulty. Arrows and explosions are not included.
hardmodeplus.stat.attack_knockback.tip: How far this mob's hits knock you back.
hardmodeplus.stat.armor_toughness.tip: Helps against strong hits (diamond 2, netherite 3 per piece).
hardmodeplus.stat.movement_speed.tip: Walking speed. Small numbers: zombie 0.23, spider 0.3. Even +0.05 is a lot.
hardmodeplus.stat.flying_speed.tip: Only for flying mobs like bees or vexes.
hardmodeplus.stat.jump_strength.tip: How high the mob jumps (vanilla mostly 0.42).
hardmodeplus.stat.step_height.tip: How high edges the mob walks up without jumping (1 = full block).
hardmodeplus.stat.water_movement_efficie: 0 to 1. How well the mob moves in water (1 = like on land).
hardmodeplus.stat.follow_range.tip: In blocks: how far the mob notices and follows you.
hardmodeplus.stat.scale.tip: 1 = normal, 2 = twice as big. Also changes the hitbox.
hardmodeplus.stat.explosion_knockback_re: 0 to 1. How little explosions push the mob away.
hardmodeplus.stat.burning_time.tip: Factor for how long the mob burns. 0 = fire goes out at once, 1 = normal.
hardmodeplus.stat.safe_fall_distance.tip: Blocks the mob can fall without damage.
hardmodeplus.stat.spawn_reinforcements_c: 0 to 1. Chance that a hit zombie calls for help (only on Hard). Vanilla is random, shown is the base value.
hardmodeplus.hard.general.tip: Added to every area below. Quick setting for everything.
hardmodeplus.hard.health.tip: More maximum health for hostile and neutral mobs.
hardmodeplus.hard.damage.tip: All damage a mob deals to players: melee, arrows, explosions, magic.
hardmodeplus.hard.speed.tip: Walking and flying speed. Even +20 % is very noticeable.
hardmodeplus.hard.follow_range.tip: How far mobs notice and follow you.
hardmodeplus.command.status.off: HardmodePlus is off (%s values changed, they stay saved).
hardmodeplus.command.reload: HardmodePlus: settings reloaded from the file.
hardmodeplus.command.off: HardmodePlus is now off. Everything is vanilla, your settings stay saved.
hardmodeplus.preset.relaxed.tip: Survival rules as in every preset: heart loss, view edge, sleep healing, hunger rules, thirst, stamina, tiredness, dazed, blast shock, cold, bleeding, broken bones and burning torches. Mobs stay vanilla.
hardmodeplus.preset.tougher.tip: Survival rules as in every preset: heart loss, view edge, sleep healing, hunger rules, thirst, stamina, tiredness, dazed, blast shock, cold, bleeding, broken bones and burning torches. Plus health and damage +25 %, speed +7.5 %, follow range +37.5 %, 10 % more monsters, mob variants (8 %) and 10 % less experience.
hardmodeplus.preset.veteran.tip: Survival rules as in every preset: heart loss, view edge, sleep healing, hunger rules, thirst, stamina, tiredness, dazed, blast shock, cold, bleeding, broken bones and burning torches. Plus health and damage +50 %, speed +15 %, follow range +75 %, zombies and spiders a bit faster, skeletons see 24 blocks. 25 % more monsters, mob variants (15 %), 25 % less experience, monster loot only from players.
hardmodeplus.preset.nightmare.tip: Survival rules as in every preset: heart loss, view edge, sleep healing, hunger rules, thirst, stamina, tiredness, dazed, blast shock, cold, bleeding, broken bones and burning torches. Plus health and damage +75 %, speed +22.5 %, follow range +112.5 %, zombies and skeletons with 2 armor, zombies call for help more often, faster spiders and creepers. 40 % more monsters, mob variants (23 %), 40 % less experience, siege nights, monster and golem loot only from players.
hardmodeplus.preset.realism.tip: Survival rules as in every preset: heart loss, view edge, sleep healing, hunger rules, thirst, stamina, tiredness, dazed, blast shock, cold, bleeding, broken bones and burning torches. Plus health and damage +100 %, speed +30 %, follow range +150 %, zombies and skeletons with 4 armor, zombies call for help even more, fast spiders and creepers. 50 % more monsters, mob variants (30 %), half the experience, siege nights, monster and golem loot only from players.
hardmodeplus.profiles.title: Profiles
hardmodeplus.profiles.name: Profile name
hardmodeplus.profiles.save.tip: Stores the current values and the adjustment mode in this slot.
hardmodeplus.profiles.save.confirm.title: Overwrite "%s"?
hardmodeplus.profiles.save.confirm.messa: The old content of this profile is replaced.
hardmodeplus.profiles.load.tip: Replaces the current values with this profile.
hardmodeplus.profiles.clear.tip: Deletes this profile and its name.
hardmodeplus.profiles.clear.confirm.mess: The profile and its name are deleted.
hardmodeplus.load.confirm.title: Load "%s"?
hardmodeplus.load.confirm.message: All current values are replaced. Anything you haven't saved is lost.
hardmodeplus.export.tip: Saves the current settings as a file in config/hardmodeplus/profiles/, for example to share them.
hardmodeplus.import.tip: Loads a file from config/hardmodeplus/profiles/. Just drop files from others in there.
hardmodeplus.import.title: Import
hardmodeplus.import.failed: The file is broken or contains unknown entries. Nothing was changed.
hardmodeplus.import.delete.failed: The file could not be deleted.
hardmodeplus.import.delete.confirm.title: Delete "%s"?
hardmodeplus.import.delete.confirm.messa: The file is deleted for good.
hardmodeplus.options.title: HardmodePlus Options
hardmodeplus.options.page.general.tip: Mod on or off, adjustment type and multiplier for bosses.
hardmodeplus.options.page.display.tip: Sprint fix and saturation display. Only for your own game.
hardmodeplus.options.page.loot.tip: Loot and experience only when a player kills the mob: separately for monsters, golems and animals.
hardmodeplus.options.enabled.tip: OFF = all mobs are vanilla again. Your values stay saved.
hardmodeplus.options.mode.tip: Both: values per mob + multiplier (zombie 40 health + 50 % = 60). Values per mob only: the multiplier is ignored (40). Multiplier only: values per mob are ignored (20 + 50 % = 30). Your values stay saved either way.
hardmodeplus.options.bosses.tip: Whether the Ender Dragon and the Wither also get the multiplier. Values per mob always apply.
hardmodeplus.options.sprint_fix.tip: ON: When you let go of the sprint key, you stop sprinting right away (only sprint mode "Hold"). Sprinting by double-tapping forward no longer works then. Only for your own game.
hardmodeplus.options.show_saturation.tip: ON: The hidden saturation of food and thirst is shown as a gold frame around the icons. While frames are left, the bar does not go down. Only for your own game.
hardmodeplus.options.center_effects.tip: ON: Effect icons sit at the top center and are a bit bigger. Good effects on top, bad ones below. Only for your own game.
ON: Monsters drop loot and experience only when a player or their tamed pet deals the killing blow (also arrows and TNT the player lit). Death by falling, lava, drowning, cactus or magma gives nothing. So monster farms stop working. Equipment and picked up items always drop, bosses are not affected.
hardmodeplus.feature.kill_loot_golems.ti: ON: Iron and snow golems only drop loot when a player or their tamed pet kills them. Iron farms stop working.
hardmodeplus.feature.kill_loot_animals.t: ON: Animals and all other mobs drop loot and experience only when a player or their tamed pet kills them. Chicken cookers and animal farms stop working. Eggs, wool from shearing and milk stay.
hardmodeplus.welcome.title: HardmodePlus is free
hardmodeplus.welcome.message: Official download only on CurseForge and GitHub.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.hardmodep: Set the attributes of every mob, from zombies to cows, and add an extra multiplier to Hard difficulty. Optional survival features: thirst, stamina, bleeding and broken bones, tiredness, cold, mob variants, burning torches and more. Five ready-made presets. Free on CurseForge and GitHub.
hardmodeplus.config.column.value.tip: Switch, choice or number. Hover the name on the left for an explanation.
hardmodeplus.config.note_features: Every feature has its own switch, all are off by default. Applies after "Done".
hardmodeplus.config.note_features_off: The mod is switched off in the options, no feature is active.
hardmodeplus.features.health.tip: Heart loss, vision edge, blindness, sleep healing, healing, bleeding and fractures
hardmodeplus.features.food.tip: Hunger rate, hunger vignette and starvation damage
hardmodeplus.features.thirst.tip: Thirst bar, drinking, canteen and bowl of water
hardmodeplus.features.condition.tip: Dazed, tiredness, exhaustion, blast shock and cold
hardmodeplus.features.player.tip: Safe surface, siege night, number of monsters, experience, torches
hardmodeplus.feature.death_penalty.tip: After each death you have fewer hearts for a while. Several deaths add up, up to the limit.
hardmodeplus.feature.death_hearts.tip: How many hearts each death costs (0.5 to 10).
hardmodeplus.feature.death_hours.tip: How long the hearts stay lost. 1 in-game hour = 50 seconds, 24 = one Minecraft day. Each new death restarts the time, sleeping does not shorten it.
hardmodeplus.feature.death_max_hearts.ti: You cannot lose more hearts than this through several deaths (0.5 to 9.5).
hardmodeplus.feature.low_health_dark.tip: With every lost heart the screen edge gets bigger and darker. Shortly before death you can hardly see anything.
hardmodeplus.feature.low_health_from.tip: The edge appears after this many lost hearts (0.5 to 19).
hardmodeplus.feature.low_health_max.tip: How dark the edge gets when only 1 heart is left (10 to 100). Until then it gets darker with every lost half heart.
hardmodeplus.feature.low_health_curve.ti: Linear: every lost half heart gets equally darker. Rising: little at first, then much faster when health is low.
hardmodeplus.feature.low_health_base.tip: Your hearts: measured against your current hearts. Standard (10 hearts): hearts missing after a death make the edge darker too.
hardmodeplus.feature.low_health_blind.ti: On top of the edge you go blind when there is hardly any health left. It stops after healing.
hardmodeplus.feature.low_health_blind_at: At this many hearts or fewer you go blind (0.5 to 10).
hardmodeplus.feature.sleep_heal.tip: If you sleep through the night in a bed, you wake up healed, but hungrier. Only if you are missing hearts.
hardmodeplus.feature.sleep_hearts.tip: How many hearts you heal when you wake up (0.5 to 10).
hardmodeplus.feature.sleep_food.tip: How much food healing in sleep costs (0 to 20). 2 = one drumstick.
hardmodeplus.feature.heal.tip: Changes natural healing: how much food it costs, from which food bar it starts and whether fast healing at a full bar stays.
hardmodeplus.feature.food.tip: Switches on all settings below. Replaces the vanilla starvation damage with its own.
hardmodeplus.feature.food_use.tip: How fast the food bar drops. 100 = vanilla, 200 = twice as fast, 0 = not at all.
hardmodeplus.feature.food_sprint.tip: How fast the food bar goes down while sprinting. Used instead of "Hunger rate" while you sprint. 100 = vanilla.
hardmodeplus.feature.food_idle.tip: This much hunger is always added, even when standing still (0 to 20 half drumsticks). 0.5 = half a drumstick every two minutes. 0 = like vanilla. Hunger speed applies on top.
hardmodeplus.feature.starve_dark.tip: As soon as the food bar is empty, the screen gets a dark edge. How dark, you set right below.
hardmodeplus.feature.dark_strength.tip: How dark the hunger vignette gets when starving (10 to 100). Default 80.
hardmodeplus.feature.starve_delay.tip: How long the food bar may be empty before you take damage. 0 = at once.
hardmodeplus.feature.starve_damage.tip: Damage per hit. 2 = one heart, 0 = no damage. Can kill you.
hardmodeplus.feature.starve_interval.tip: Time between two hits of damage (1 to 60).
hardmodeplus.feature.heal_cost.tip: How much food normal healing costs. 100 = vanilla, 200 = twice as much, 0 = nothing at all.
hardmodeplus.feature.heal_from.tip: You only heal by yourself from this much food on (1 to 20). 18 = vanilla (9 drumsticks).
hardmodeplus.feature.fast_heal.tip: ON: At a full food bar you heal extra fast like in vanilla. OFF: Only normal healing then too.
hardmodeplus.feature.thirst.tip: Its own thirst bar above the food bar. Drink with a water bottle, milk, the canteen or a bowl of water. Empty, it hurts.
hardmodeplus.feature.thirst_idle.tip: This much thirst is always added, even when standing still (0 to 20 half drops). 2 = one drop.
hardmodeplus.feature.thirst_sprint.tip: This much is added on top while sprinting (0 to 60 half drops). With 11 thirst goes down a bit faster than the food bar while sprinting.
hardmodeplus.feature.thirst_exhaust.tip: This much thirst (half drops) is added at once when you sprint until exhausted (0 to 20). Only with "Exhaustion" in the Condition tab.
hardmodeplus.feature.thirst_heat.tip: ON: In desert, savanna, badlands and the Nether you get thirsty twice as fast.
hardmodeplus.feature.thirst_first_day.ti: On the first day of the world (the first 20 minutes) thirst only rises at this share (50 to 100). 50 = half as fast, 100 = normal.
hardmodeplus.feature.thirst_stamina.tip: ON: With few thirst drops your stamina recovers slower. Only with "Exhaustion" in the Condition tab.
hardmodeplus.feature.thirst_stamina_from: At and below this level recovery gets slower (1 to 20). 6 = three drops.
hardmodeplus.feature.thirst_stamina_rege: How much slower stamina recovers with an empty thirst bar (0 to 90). Evenly less in between.
hardmodeplus.feature.thirst_delay.tip: How long the thirst bar may be empty before you take damage. 0 = at once.
hardmodeplus.feature.thirst_damage.tip: Damage per hit. 2 = one heart, 0 = no damage. Can kill you.
hardmodeplus.feature.thirst_interval.tip: Time between two hits of damage (1 to 60).
hardmodeplus.feature.thirst_water.tip: How far a water bottle refills the thirst bar (0 to 20 half drops). 6 = three drops.
hardmodeplus.feature.thirst_water_sat.ti: Hidden saturation of a water bottle (0 to 20 half drops). It is used up first, only then the thirst bar goes down. Never more than the bar is full.
hardmodeplus.feature.thirst_milk.tip: How far a bucket of milk refills the thirst bar (0 to 20 half drops). 20 = ten drops.
hardmodeplus.feature.thirst_milk_sat.tip: Hidden saturation of a bucket of milk (0 to 20 half drops). It is used up first, only then the thirst bar goes down.
hardmodeplus.feature.thirst_flask.tip: How far one sip from the canteen refills the thirst bar (0 to 20 half drops). 10 = five drops.
hardmodeplus.feature.thirst_flask_sat.ti: Hidden saturation per sip from the canteen (0 to 20 half drops). It is used up first, only then the thirst bar goes down.
hardmodeplus.feature.flask_sips.tip: How many sips fit into a canteen (1 to 10). Right-click on water fills it up.
hardmodeplus.feature.thirst_bowl.tip: How far a bowl of water fills the thirst bar (0 to 20 half drops). 2 = one drop.
hardmodeplus.feature.thirst_bowl_sat.tip: Hidden reserve used up before the bar (0 to 20 half drops).
item.hardmodeplus.canteen.tip: Right-click on water to fill it up.
item.hardmodeplus.water_bowl.tip: Drinking quenches a little thirst, the bowl is left over. Fill: right-click on water with an empty bowl.
hardmodeplus.feature.backstab.tip: If an enemy hits you from behind (melee, arrow, explosion), you are dazed and slower for a moment.
hardmodeplus.feature.backstab_slow.tip: How many percent slower you get (1 to 90).
hardmodeplus.feature.backstab_seconds.ti: How long the slowness lasts (0.5 to 30).
hardmodeplus.feature.tired.tip: Whoever does not sleep for several nights mines blocks slower and recovers slower. Sleeping through once in a bed ends the tiredness.
hardmodeplus.feature.tired_nights.tip: After this many nights of the world without sleep you get tired (1 to 10). Sleeping through once in a bed resets the count.
hardmodeplus.feature.tired_slow.tip: How much slower you break blocks once you are tired (5 to 90).
hardmodeplus.feature.tired_step.tip: Every further night without sleep adds this much (0 to 50). 90 % at most in total.
hardmodeplus.feature.tired_regen.tip: While you are tired, the stamina fills up this much slower (0 to 90). Only with "Exhaustion".
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust.tip: Sprinting uses up stamina, walking and standing refill it. When it is empty you are exhausted: slower and no sprinting.
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_seconds.tip: How long you can sprint in one go with full stamina (5 to 120).
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_jump.tip: Every jump while sprinting costs this much extra stamina (0 to 10).
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_low.tip: In the last third of the stamina the use goes down to this many percent (10 to 100). 70 = 30 % slower at the end, 100 = always the same.
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_curve.tip: Linear: the use goes down evenly. Exponential: hardly at first, clearly just before empty.
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_walk.tip: How long it takes while walking until the stamina is full again (5 to 300).
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_stand.tip: How long it takes while standing still until the stamina is full again (2 to 300).
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_slow.tip: How many percent slower you get while exhausted (5 to 90).
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_rest.tip: Once exhausted, you stay exhausted until the stamina is back to this share of the maximum (5 to 100).
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_mine.tip: As soon as you are exhausted, you break blocks this much slower (0 to 90). 0 = not at all.
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_mine_second: How long you mine slower after becoming exhausted (1 to 60).
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_bar.tip: ON: A bar right above the experience bar shows the stamina. It turns red while you are exhausted.
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_levels.tip: ON: How long you can sprint grows with the highest experience level you ever reached. It stays after death. Replaces "Stamina (s)" then.
This much stamina is added per level (0 to 5). With a 10 s start and 0.5 s you reach 30 s at level 40.
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_level_max.t: No more stamina than this, even at higher levels (5 to 120).
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_actions.tip: ON: Mining, building and hits cost stamina. It does not recover right after. With empty stamina you are exhausted like after sprinting.
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_break.tip: How much of the full stamina a stone block costs (0 to 20). Softer blocks cost less, harder ones more (at most three times). Blocks that break instantly like grass cost nothing.
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_tool.tip: With a better tool, mining costs less stamina (0 to 90). Hand and wood pay full, stone a bit less, netherite saves this share. Uses the mining speed of the tool, so changed values from GearBalance count too. Gold is very fast, so it saves a lot as well.
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_place.tip: How much of the full stamina a placed block costs (0 to 20).
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_attack.tip: How much a fully charged hit costs (0 to 20). Fast clicking costs less per hit, at least a fifth.
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_jumping.tip: How much of the full stamina a normal jump costs (0 to 20). Sprint jumps cost via "Jump cost (s)" under Exhaustion.
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_pause.tip: How long stamina does not recover after an action (0 to 10).
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_enough.tip: ON: Jumping, mining, building and attacking only work if there is enough stamina left for that exact action. A hard block or a full hit needs more than a jump.
hardmodeplus.feature.exhaust_bar.warn: Note: this only hides the bar. Exhaustion still works!
hardmodeplus.feature.blast.tip: If an explosion hits you (creeper, TNT, ghast), you are dazed and slower for a moment.
hardmodeplus.feature.blast_min.tip: The shock only comes from this much explosion damage on (1 to 20). 2 = one heart.
hardmodeplus.feature.blast_seconds.tip: How long the shock lasts (1 to 30).
hardmodeplus.feature.blast_slow.tip: How much slower you are right after the explosion (0 to 90). Fades until the shock is over. 0 = no slowness.
hardmodeplus.feature.blast_nausea.tip: Your view gets blurry, strong right after the explosion, then weaker and weaker (vanilla effect Nausea).
hardmodeplus.feature.cold.tip: In cold biomes you slowly freeze, like in powder snow: blue screen edge, slower, damage in the end. Leather armor, fire and lava help.
hardmodeplus.feature.cold_temp.tip: Below this biome temperature it is cold (-1 to 2). 0.15 = snowy biomes. Higher up it is colder.
hardmodeplus.feature.cold_seconds.tip: How long it takes without protection until you are fully frozen and take damage (5 to 300). Warming up is twice as fast.
hardmodeplus.feature.cold_night.tip: ON: At night it is a bit colder everywhere (biome temperature -0.2).
hardmodeplus.feature.cold_leather.tip: How much each piece of leather armor protects (0 to 25). 25 = with all 4 pieces you are fully protected.
hardmodeplus.feature.cold_fire.tip: ON: Near fire, campfires, lava or magma blocks (3 blocks) you don't freeze.
hardmodeplus.feature.bleed.tip: Hits from monsters can cause bleeding: light (a bandage or tourniquet helps) or heavy (only the tourniquet helps). Until treated you take damage again and again.
hardmodeplus.feature.bleed_min.tip: Only from this much damage per hit on bleeding can start (1 to 40). 4 = two hearts.
hardmodeplus.feature.bleed_chance.tip: Chance of light bleeding per hit (0 to 100).
hardmodeplus.feature.bleed_damage.tip: Damage of light bleeding per hit (0 to 20).
hardmodeplus.feature.bleed_interval.tip: Time between two hits of light bleeding (1 to 60).
hardmodeplus.feature.heavy_chance.tip: Chance of heavy bleeding per hit (0 to 100). Light bleeding can turn heavy.
hardmodeplus.feature.heavy_damage.tip: Damage of heavy bleeding per hit (0 to 20).
hardmodeplus.feature.heavy_interval.tip: Time between two hits of heavy bleeding (1 to 60).
hardmodeplus.feature.bandage_seconds.tip: How long you hold right-click to put on a bandage (0.5 to 20). Only helps against light bleeding.
How long you hold right-click to put on a tourniquet (0.5 to 20). Stops any bleeding.
hardmodeplus.feature.herbal_seconds.tip: How long you hold right-click to put on a herbal bandage (0.5 to 20).
hardmodeplus.feature.herbal_hearts.tip: How many hearts a herbal bandage heals (0.5 to 20). It also stops light bleeding.
hardmodeplus.feature.bandage_hearts.tip: How many hearts a bandage heals when it stops a bleeding (0 to 20).
hardmodeplus.feature.tourniquet_hearts.t: How many hearts a tourniquet heals when it stops a bleeding (0 to 20).
hardmodeplus.feature.fracture.tip: A high fall can break a bone: you are slower, can't sprint and limp. You can't jump, but you step up one block by yourself. A splint helps for now, a cast heals the bone.
hardmodeplus.feature.fracture_from.tip: From this fall height on a bone can break (1 to 50).
hardmodeplus.feature.fracture_chance.tip: Chance of a broken bone between "Chance from" and "Sure from" (0 to 100).
hardmodeplus.feature.fracture_sure.tip: From this fall height the bone always breaks (2 to 100).
hardmodeplus.feature.fracture_slow.tip: How much slower you are with a broken bone (0 to 90). Only half as much with a splint or a cast.
hardmodeplus.feature.cast_seconds.tip: How long you hold right-click to put on a cast (0.5 to 20).
hardmodeplus.feature.cast_hours.tip: How many in-game hours the bone needs in the cast until it is healed (0.5 to 240). Until then you still limp, but only half as slow. 24 = one in-game day. Only real played time counts, not /time or sleeping.
hardmodeplus.feature.cast_instant.tip: ON: The cast heals the bone at once, the healing time is not used.
hardmodeplus.feature.splint_seconds.tip: How long you hold right-click to put on a splint (0.5 to 20).
hardmodeplus.feature.splint_days.tip: How many in-game days a splint holds. Then it breaks and you are fully slowed again (0.5 to 30).
item.hardmodeplus.tourniquet.tip: Hold right-click: stops any bleeding, heavy too.
item.hardmodeplus.splint.tip: Hold right-click: splints a broken bone. You are only half as slow, but after a few days the splint breaks. Only a cast heals the bone.
item.hardmodeplus.herbal_bandage.tip: Hold right-click while lightly bleeding: stops it and heals hearts too.
item.hardmodeplus.cast.tip: Hold right-click: puts on a cast, also over a splint. The bone then heals over time.
hardmodeplus.feature.safe_surface.tip: Once the Ender Dragon has been defeated in this world, no monsters spawn under the open sky in the Overworld. Caves and spawners stay the same.
hardmodeplus.feature.siege.tip: Every few days a night becomes a siege: monsters see much farther and (with "Lure monsters") come straight for you. Dig in!
hardmodeplus.feature.siege_days.tip: Which night is a siege night (every 2 to 100 days).
hardmodeplus.feature.siege_range.tip: How far monsters see at least during the siege night. Also the radius for luring (16 to 128).
hardmodeplus.feature.siege_attract.tip: Monsters in range know where you are and walk to you, even if they cannot see you.
hardmodeplus.feature.siege_message.tip: Announces the start and end of the siege night in the chat.
hardmodeplus.feature.mob_count.tip: ON: More or fewer monsters than in vanilla, per area. 100 = vanilla, 200 = twice as many, 0 = none. Applies to naturally spawning monsters, not to spawners and structures.
hardmodeplus.feature.spawn_surface.tip: Monsters under the open sky in the overworld (0 to 300).
hardmodeplus.feature.spawn_caves.tip: Monsters with no sky above them: caves, under roofs and trees (0 to 300). Surface and caves share one limit in Minecraft, so the split is only roughly exact.
hardmodeplus.feature.spawn_end.tip: Monsters in the End, mostly endermen (0 to 300).
hardmodeplus.feature.growth.tip: Monsters start like vanilla and get a bit stronger every world day, until your values count in full on the set day. Works on the mob values, the multiplier and the mob variants. Counts the world days like the F3 screen, sleeping and /time count too.
hardmodeplus.feature.growth_days.tip: On this world day your set values count in full (1 to 365). With 30, monsters are half as boosted on day 15.
hardmodeplus.feature.scaling.tip: Every world day adds a surcharge on health, damage, speed and follow range on top of your values. Only on Hard, like the multiplier. With "Monsters grow stronger" on, the surcharge only starts after the day of full strength.
hardmodeplus.feature.scaling_per_day.tip: How many percent are added per world day (0.5 to 20).
hardmodeplus.feature.scaling_max.tip: The surcharge never goes higher (1 to 300). With 2 % per day and at most 50 %, the top is reached after 25 days.
hardmodeplus.feature.xp.tip: ON: You get more or less experience than in vanilla, from all sources (orbs, trading, furnace, also commands like /experience add).
hardmodeplus.feature.xp_gain.tip: How much more or less experience you get (-90 to 120). 0 = vanilla, -50 = half, 100 = double.
hardmodeplus.feature.torches.tip: ON: Torches you place go out after the set time and leave a stick. Torches in villages and mines, soul torches and redstone torches stay. Torches placed while the switch was off never go out.
hardmodeplus.feature.torch_minutes.tip: How long a torch burns (1 to 240 real minutes). 20 = one Minecraft day. Applies to newly placed torches.
hardmodeplus.feature.variants.tip: Zombies (also babies), skeletons, spiders, cave spiders and creepers randomly spawn as a fast, tough, strong or random variant. The variant is rolled when the mob first appears and stays saved with it. You can tell them by their own skin and size. Other monsters never become variants, but get the spread if it is on.
hardmodeplus.feature.variant_scale.tip: ON: Fast variants are a bit smaller, tough ones bigger, strong ones a bit bigger (set per variant). With spread the size varies slightly. A mob is never smaller than 50 % or bigger than 130 %.
hardmodeplus.feature.variant_share.tip: This many of all monsters spawn as a variant (0 to 30). The rest is always normal, so at least 70 %. The variant weights split this share. Applies to newly appearing monsters.
hardmodeplus.feature.variant_underground: ON: In the overworld only monsters that appear below the set height with a real block above them become variants (caves, under roofs; leaves don't count). In the Nether and End this always counts.
Variants only below this height (-64 to 320). 50 = well below the surface, sea level is 63.
hardmodeplus.feature.fast_weight.tip: How much of the variant share goes to the fast variant. The four weights are turned into 100 %, equal numbers = equally often. 0 = never. Skin: blue.
hardmodeplus.feature.fast_speed.tip: How much faster the fast variant is (-90 to 500).
hardmodeplus.feature.fast_health.tip: Health of the fast variant compared to the normal mob (-90 to 500). -20 = a bit less.
hardmodeplus.feature.fast_size.tip: Size of the fast variant (-50 to 30). Only with "Size shows variant".
hardmodeplus.feature.tough_weight.tip: How much of the variant share goes to the tough variant. The four weights are turned into 100 %, equal numbers = equally often. 0 = never. Skin: elite.
hardmodeplus.feature.tough_health.tip: How much more health the tough variant has (-90 to 500). 100 = twice as much.
hardmodeplus.feature.tough_speed.tip: Speed of the tough variant (-90 to 500). -15 = a bit slower.
hardmodeplus.feature.tough_knockback.tip: How much less knockback the tough variant gets (0 to 100). 100 = none at all.
hardmodeplus.feature.tough_size.tip: Size of the tough variant (-50 to 30). Only with "Size shows variant".
hardmodeplus.feature.strong_weight.tip: How much of the variant share goes to the strong variant. The four weights are turned into 100 %, equal numbers = equally often. 0 = never. Skin: red.
hardmodeplus.feature.strong_damage.tip: How much more damage the strong variant deals to players (-90 to 500), also with arrows and explosions.
hardmodeplus.feature.strong_size.tip: Size of the strong variant (-50 to 30). Only with "Size shows variant".
hardmodeplus.feature.random_weight.tip: How much of the variant share goes to the random variant. The four weights are turned into 100 %, equal numbers = equally often. 0 = never. Skin: dark.
hardmodeplus.feature.random_range.tip: How far health, speed and damage of the random variant can differ at most (0 to 90). 50 = between half and one and a half times as strong.
hardmodeplus.feature.variant_random.tip: ON: All monsters get slightly random health, speed and damage (and a bit of size) when they first appear, also normal ones and those without a variant skin. So every fight is a bit different. Real variants still only come with a skin. Not for the random variant, which has its own range.
hardmodeplus.feature.variant_spread.tip: How far the random values can differ at most (0 to 90). 20 = between -20 % and +20 %.
hardmodeplus.section.variant_tough.tip: Much more health and steadier, but slower.
hardmodeplus.tab.variants.tip: Monsters spawn as a fast, tough, strong or random variant, with their own skin.
hardmodeplus.siege.start: Siege night! All monsters see you from far away.
hardmodeplus.tab.features.tip: New game rules for health, food, drinking, condition and world. Each can be switched on and off, all off by default.
hardmodeplus.section.variant_chaos.tip: Health, speed and damage are random for each of these mobs, sometimes weaker, sometimes stronger.
hardmodeplus.feature.variant_loot.tip: ON: Fast, tough, strong and random variants give more experience and more loot. Loot only when a player kills the mob.
hardmodeplus.feature.loot_xp.tip: How much more experience a variant gives (0 to 300). 50 = one and a half times as much.
hardmodeplus.feature.loot_double.tip: With this chance the mob's normal loot drops a second time (0 to 100).
hardmodeplus.feature.loot_rare.tip: With this chance a rare item drops as well: mostly 1 to 3 iron or gold nuggets, rarely an iron or gold ingot (10 %) or an emerald (5 %) (0 to 100).
